title: Pardo 43
highlights: Volvo IPS with joystick and Interceptor
Fusion and JL Audio sound system
description:
This 2020 Pardo 43 is available immediately in impeccable condition, with only 606 engine hours. She combines Italian design, strong performance and rich equipment, including a gyroscopic stabiliser, full air conditioning and a Kohler 9 kW generator.

Twin Volvo IPS 650 drives come with joystick, cruise control and the Interceptor system, while the hydraulic platform, electric bimini and Flexiteek decks make her a superb dayboat for up to eleven passengers. Price on request.
